A little about the person behind the coffee

About us

Hi, I'm Jeanny — the sole woman behind the cart, the coffee, and the smiles. My Jeanny Coffee is a mobile coffee cart service based in the Queenstown-Lakes district, bringing quality espresso to the places and people that matter most. Whether I'm rolling up to a buzzing market in Arrowtown or setting up at a corporate morning tea in Queenstown, every cup is made with care, consistency, and a genuine love for great coffee. You might know me best from the Arrowtown Autumn Market — one of Otago's most beloved seasonal events — where I've become a familiar face for locals and visitors alike. That community connection is at the heart of everything I do. This isn't a faceless franchise operation. It's just me, my cart, and a real passion for crafting the perfect flat white. From weddings in the Wakatipu Basin to festivals across Southland, I bring a warm, professional barista experience to events of all shapes and sizes. If you're looking for a mobile coffee service that feels personal, reliable, and genuinely delicious — you've found the right cart.

“From my cart to your heart.”

What we offer

Great coffee and friendly service for markets, celebrations, workplaces and outdoor gatherings.

  • Espresso, flat whites, long blacks & lattes — crafted fresh on-site
  • Cold brew & seasonal specialty drinks
  • Market day trading — regular and one-off market appearances across Queenstown & Arrowtown
  • Private event catering — weddings, birthdays, family gatherings
  • Corporate coffee service — morning teas, team events, office pop-ups
  • Festival & outdoor event catering across Otago & Southland
  • Let's Bring Great Coffee to Your Next Event
